_instructions: For each page below, open the matching image in eval/gold/images/<id>.png (or the PDF page directly) and fill in `blocks`.

`blocks` = the correct reading-order list of text chunks on the page, largest reasonable unit at a time (a heading is one block, a paragraph is one block -- don't go line-by-line). Use the SAME script/language as the page (Arabic stays Arabic, don't translate). Order matters: this is what reading-order scoring checks.
You don't have to transcribe every diacritic-perfect character -- close, faithful transcription is enough; the edit-distance metric tolerates small differences.

If a page has a real table (bordered or not), also fill in `table` as a list of rows, each row a list of cell strings, in the table's natural reading order (top-to-bottom rows; for Arabic tables, right-to-left columns). Leave `table` as null if the page has no table.
Skip a page entirely (delete its object) if you'd rather not label it -- fewer, correct labels beat more, sloppy ones.
Run: python eval/run_matrix.py eval/gold/gold.json  once you've filled at least a few pages in, to sanity-check the format before doing all of them.
